validity_policy: Local conservative 24-hour verification window, not a provider price guarantee. Refresh from official sources and create a new cohort fingerprint before further live work after expiry. Preserve old snapshots and previously calculated attempt costs.
authorization: Offline preparation only. This artifact does not authorize paid calls, dependency installation or external writes.

calendar.interpretation: Official notified holiday ranges are excluded. DeepSeek explicitly makes all weekends off-peak; weekend makeup workdays do not override that rule. No 2027 calendar is inferred.

scope: Token fees only, calculated from provider-reported prompt cache hit, cache miss and completion tokens. No guessed cache ratio, retries, Search/Fetch fees, balance deductions, discounts or invoice reconciliation. Complete zero usage may produce zero; unknown usage remains null.
hash_policy: facts_sha256 hashes UTF-8 extracted factual summaries, not downloaded page bytes. snapshot_sha256 hashes the complete JSON object except itself using sorted keys, ensure_ascii=false and compact separators. Hashes detect accidental changes; they do not authenticate a remote page.

sources.facts: deepseek-flash serves DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017. CNY per million tokens: off-peak cache hit 0.02, cache miss 1, output 4; peak cache hit 0.04, cache miss 2, output 8. Beijing Monday-Friday excluding Chinese public holidays peak 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00; all other periods and all weekends/public holidays off-peak. Prices may change.

Chat completion usage reports prompt_tokens, prompt_cache_hit_tokens, prompt_cache_miss_tokens and completion_tokens. Prompt tokens equal cache hit plus cache miss. Completion tokens count generated completion; total_tokens equals prompt plus completion.
